## Section 03. Design Principles conformity

- [ ] I have read [DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md](../DESIGN-PRINCIPLES.md).
- [ ] This change recommends a process rather than determining a substantive outcome (Section 01).
- [ ] Any default or starting point is labeled as one, with somewhere for collaborators to record what they actually decide (Sections 02 and 03).
- [ ] Access, responsibility, approval authority, platform role, and IP treatment are kept distinct (Section 04).
- [ ] No jurisdiction-specific assumption has been imported (Section 07).
- [ ] I have checked whether another file, template, guide, or module needs to change with this one (Section 14).

## Section 04. Governance checklist

- [ ] Does this affect intended IP treatment?
- [ ] Does this affect money or revenue terms?
- [ ] Does this affect access or infrastructure custody?
- [ ] Does this affect responsibilities or roles?
- [ ] Does this affect exit terms?
- [ ] Does this change the Working Agreement?
- [ ] Does this change governance rules?
- [ ] Does this change CODEOWNERS or review responsibility?

If any box is checked, follow the governance-change approval requirements in [GOVERNANCE.md](../GOVERNANCE.md).
